results.name: Dirty roster values retain their original version after another session saves and automatic polling rejects the stale write
A saved roster baseline uses the mutation version when bootstrap fails, and input is locked during the in-flight save
Manual refresh updates an open filtered report after another session approves a cross-lab swap and agrees exactly with CSV
Old report responses cannot overwrite newer laboratory filters and report errors preserve filters while disabling exports until retry
Automatic revision-driven preview and report reads use background headers, retain focus and do not keep idle sessions alive
Two real availability tabs reject different-cell and same-cell stale saves without undoing the first tab
Report refresh and route cleanup produce no unhandled page errors or PHP warnings

standaloneLint.detail: No ESLint script or configuration exists. The production JSX build, JavaScript syntax checks, Prettier check and React skill checklist were completed.

review: Editable values and version share one snapshot; stale writes preserve input and require explicit reload.
Returned mutation versions establish baselines even if bootstrap fails; inputs are disabled while saving.
Initial navigation, filter changes, manual refresh and retry are foreground; revision-driven dependent reads are background.
Request cancellation, sequence checks and deferred once-only invalidation prevent old results and refresh loops.
Reports keep filters and loading/error states; stale snapshots cannot be exported or printed after a failed refresh.
Queued Canvas resize callbacks safely ignore an unmounted chart.
isolation: Generated synthetic credentials and unique temporary state/sessions only. The supplied operational store was not used. Temporary server and fixture directory were removed.
